title: He's Out. Or Is He?
subject: Jensen Huang
role: Founder, resigned as Nvidia CEO on Nov 12, 2026
parody: Parody game. The situation is real and linked below; every statement, headline and reaction in the game is invented. Not affiliated with or endorsed by anyone depicted.

setup.headline: He's out. Or is he?
setup.dek: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on Thursday, days after opening an investigation into reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Two big investors now want him back. He has one statement to read. You write it.

context: Real situation, mid-November 2026: Nov 8 the Nvidia board opened an independent investigation into reports Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort (a contact linked to Megaspeed, a Singapore firm that bought billions in Nvidia gear and is probed over export controls). The FBI is looking into it. Nov 12 he resigned as CEO and director; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey Jones the first board chair. Nvidia lost over $600B in market value that week. Nov 14 two major investors urged the board to consider his return. House committee chairs want him at a closed-door briefing on Nov 18; his trip to APEC in Shenzhen is in doubt. Keep everything non-sexual.

blanks.question: Did you resign, or were you pushed?
blanks.source: The board accepted his resignation on Nov 12, hours after reports it was preparing to remove him.

options.text: stepped down as CEO of Nvidia
agreed with the board that it was time for me to step aside
walked out of the company I built, and I took the jacket with me
“resigned”, which at a $4 trillion company is the same verb as pushed
was not pushed. I was rendered. In 4K. With ray tracing

blanks.question: The President says you told him you had no idea your contact was an alleged spy. True?
blanks.source: On Nov 9 the President said the FBI was looking into it and that Huang told him he had no idea.

options.text: that is a matter for the investigation, and I am cooperating fully
I told the President the truth, and I will tell investigators the same
if I had known, do you think I would still be taking your calls
in Silicon Valley everyone is a spy; we just call it networking
I cannot detect spies. I can only detect frame drops

blanks.question: Three House committee chairs want you at a closed-door briefing on Nov 18, or a subpoena. Will you go?
blanks.source: Three House Republican committee chairs asked him to attend a closed-door briefing on Nov 18.

options.text: my lawyers are reviewing the request
I will be there on the 18th and answer every question I can
I will bring slides, and they will love the slides
I am happy to finally explain what a GPU is
I will attend as a hologram, rendered live on 72 H200s

blanks.question: Nvidia lost $600 billion in a week. What do you tell us?
blanks.source: Nvidia lost more than $600 billion in market value in the week of Nov 9.

options.text: our fundamentals are unchanged and demand remains strong
I am sorry, and the team that built this is still here
we will make it back by Christmas. Watch
relax, it is only one Apple. We have more
think of it as a discount. Buy the dip. Buy my jacket. Buy everything

blanks.question: We asked the board to consider your return. What is your pitch?
blanks.source: On Nov 14 two major investors urged the board to consider the potential return of Jensen Huang.

options.text: that is the board's decision
I would only return if the board, the investigation and our people all agree
I started this company in a Denny's booth. Give me the keys and a booth
good luck explaining CUDA to the next CEO
reinstate me and I will hand-deliver every GPU. By scooter
